name: Incline Dumbbell Skull Crusher
research: Body, 30 deg bench, feet, spine copied from the proven incline_dumbbell_press. Its elev 118 = vertical arm, so the torso frame is ~62 deg back from vertical: Z_t = (0, 0.88, 0.47) world, Y_t = (0, -0.47, 0.88). Upper arm elev 120 / plane 90: du_t = (0, 0.87, 0.5) -> world (0, 0.03, 1.0) = straight up (library 'held straight up'), held in both pictures. Fold toward the head (bend [0,0,1]): bperp = (0, -0.5, 0.87). Elbow 5 -> 95: E = S + 0.29 du = (0.22, 0.25, 0.15); forearm = du cos95 + bperp sin95 = (0, -0.57, 0.82); hand = E + 0.33 fore = (0.22, 0.06, 0.42) torso = behind and beside the head, 6 cm in front of the shoulder line (pad face is ~10 cm behind it). Neutral handle square to the forearm in the fold plane: start = bperp (0, -0.5, 0.87); end rotated 95 deg = (0, -0.82, -0.57). S1 Boehler 2011, S2 Maeo 2023 (shoulder-flexed long-head emphasis), S3 Rodriguez-Ridao 2020 (bench setup).
